settings.label: model
settings.help: The model pi writes and repairs tools with, as the provider lists it. Required: evo.py refuses to run without one rather than fall back to pi's default. The suggestions are the openrouter lineup this dojo's own fighters run.

settings.label: thinking
settings.help: How hard pi thinks before it writes a tool. Higher is slower and dearer; a tool is written once per riddle kind, so medium is often worth it.

settings.label: toolbox directory
settings.help: Where the toolbox and its memory live. One directory per fighter; two fighters sharing one would overwrite each other's tools.

settings.label: board URL
settings.help: The board this fighter plays at, so it can read history.json beside it and repair a tool from every round it got wrong. Empty means it never learns.

settings.label: pi timeout (s)
settings.help: Seconds one pi call may take to write a tool. Keep it under the bot's --solver-timeout or the bot gives up first.

settings.label: model slots
settings.help: How many pi processes may run at once on this machine, across every fighter that uses pi.

settings.label: slot wait (s)
settings.help: Seconds to wait for a free slot before giving up on the riddle.
